shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼夺点击，交代衣身廓形、圆领与胸前立体装饰的整体比例关系。
一秒法则把胸前立体装饰这条主卖点讲完，只留一句主张。
shots.textZone: 左上扇贝形吊牌位承载一句主卖点，其余无文案

shots.intent: 让家长会代入日常出门场景，用动态摆幅交代版型与活动余量。
把洗后印花开裂脱落、立体装饰塌软的日常烦恼摊开给家长看。
用领圈包边与走线的实拍微距证明做工，替家长排除变形起皱的疑虑。
正面微距交代立体装饰的层次与附着状态，把工艺卖点变成可见证据。
用空白格位承接尺码与参数表，既补齐信息又不搬运源页数字。
把同款多色一次摊平供家长挑色，三色光线与折叠方式完全一致。
以侧缝、卷边与空白织标的实拍做工收尾降风险，不引用任何资质数字。
用叠装组合与两个空白按钮位收口，把搭配与多件购买的念头留下。
shots.textZone: 左上扇贝吊牌位与右下圆角按钮位各一句占位文案

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool candy-shop childrenswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a seamless milk-juice paper field #FBF2ED, a curved matte candy-pink plaster half-dome #F3BCC4 carrying one scalloped die-cut paper valance, deep plum ink #4B2C44 for copy, rules and the low-key field, and one mint-sugar accent #6EC1A8 used only as hairlines, thin line icons and empty swatch tiles; cool daylight-balanced studio light at about 6500K from a large diffuser panel high in front with a bounce card on the shadow side, one narrow skimming side accent to open knit loops, soft true contact shadow under every hem and folded layer, no harsh speculars and never a warm cast; surfaces are a sugar-flecked milk-glass slab and matte plaster, never wood, rattan, asphalt or tile; one modern geometric sans-serif for all Chinese and Latin labels plus one wide-tracked small-cap kicker rail; in-image Chinese only as a blank scalloped tag chip or rounded button lozenge carrying placeholder copy, every measurement, index and specification slot left empty with no digits or units; thin single-weight mint line icons only, no filled emblems and no seal realism; garments stay flat, unwrinkled and lint-free, the chest relief motif never redrawn, any child model cropped below the chin or from behind with no identifiable face, sleeves folded identically in matched rows; stable garment scale and placement; no color palette changes, no new hue outside the four locked tones, no mixed fonts, no serif or brush lettering, no random backgrounds, no outdoor ground, no furnished interior, no inconsistent lighting, no warm cast, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered numbers of any kind.
